name: OIST PhD Scholarship
host: Okinawa Institute of Science and Technology
deadlineNote: Admissions Workshop 2027 round; interviews 18 Jan to 7 Feb 2027; enrol May 2027, Sept 2027 or Jan 2028. Application fee JPY 5,000
who: All nationalities
value: Tuition waived, stipend about JPY 2.4M/yr, relocation, housing support
english: TOEFL iBT or IELTS only if your degree was not taught in English; no minimum score
note: Rotation-based first year, no supervisor needed before applying.

name: Yenching Academy Scholarship
who: All nationalities
value: Tuition, accommodation, stipend, one return airfare, 2-year China Studies MA
english: TOEFL/IELTS unless degree was in English
note: Interdisciplinary China Studies; strong fit for policy backgrounds.

name: Excellence Scholarship (ESOP)
deadlineNote: Same deadline as the Master's application
who: All nationalities
value: CHF 12,000 per semester plus tuition waiver
note: Top 10% of class; apply with the Master's application.

name: Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme
deadlineNote: Initial application to RGC by 12:00 noon HKT; full application to your chosen university the same day
who: All nationalities
value: HKD 344,400/yr stipend plus HKD 14,400/yr conference grant, up to 3 years; universities add tuition support
note: Apply to RGC first, then to up to two universities (HKU, HKUST, CUHK and others).

name: Gates Cambridge Scholarship
deadlineNote: 8 Dec 2026 or 6 Jan 2027 depending on course (see the Cambridge course directory); applications opened 11 Sep 2026; US citizens in the US had a 14 Oct 2026 deadline
who: Any nationality other than UK; US citizens resident in the US apply in the October round
value: Full tuition, stipend about GBP 21,000/yr, airfare, visa, family allowance
note: Tick the Gates box on the Cambridge application; one form does both.

name: MBZUAI Graduate Scholarship
who: All nationalities
value: Full tuition, monthly stipend, housing, health insurance
note: Every admitted student is funded; CS, ML, CV, NLP, robotics.

name: Research Training Program (RTP)
who: Domestic and international
value: Tuition offset plus stipend about AUD 41,000/yr
note: Supervisor and proposal needed before the scholarship round.

name: Nanyang President's Graduate Scholarship
who: All nationalities
value: Full tuition, stipend about SGD 3,100 to 3,300/month, travel, IT allowance
note: First-class honours or equivalent expected.

name: KAUST Fellowship
who: All nationalities
value: Full tuition, stipend USD 20,000 to 30,000/yr, housing, medical, relocation
note: All admitted students receive the fellowship; GRE recommended.

name: Eiffel Excellence Scholarship
deadlineNote: Institutional deadline; your French university nominates you earlier
who: Non-French nationals under 25 (Master's) or 30 (PhD)
value: EUR 1,181/month (Master's) or 1,700/month (PhD), travel, insurance; tuition not covered
english: Per programme; many taught in English
note: The French institution must nominate you; contact them in November.

name: Erasmus Mundus Euroculture
who: All nationalities, EU and non-EU quotas
value: Tuition, EUR 1,400/month, travel and installation, 2 years in two EU countries
note: Studies in two of eight partner universities.

name: Chevening Scholarships
host: UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office
window: Opens early August, closes early November each year
who: Citizens of Chevening-eligible countries with 2+ years' work experience; must return home for 2 years
value: Full tuition, monthly stipend, travel, visa, arrival allowance for a one-year UK Master's
english: Per university; Chevening itself no longer sets a test requirement
note: Apply to Chevening first, then secure an unconditional offer from a UK university by the following July.

name: DAAD EPOS Development-Related Postgraduate Courses
window: Varies by course; most close between August and October for the following year
who: Graduates from developing and emerging countries with at least 2 years' professional experience
value: EUR 992/month (Master's) or 1,300/month (PhD), travel, insurance, German course, tuition where charged
english: IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL 80 typical; some courses German
note: Apply to the course directly; each course has its own deadline and portal.

name: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
window: Set by each country's Fulbright commission or US embassy; most close between February and October
who: Citizens of participating countries; apply from your home country
value: Tuition, living stipend, airfare, health insurance; duration varies by country and degree
note: Placement at US universities is handled for you after selection.

name: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships
window: Opens August, closes between September and December depending on your country's embassy
who: Researchers from about 180 countries; PhD, postdoc and research fellowships (Master's only for arts)
value: CHF 1,920/month, tuition waiver at most universities, insurance, housing allowance
english: Per host; a Swiss professor's support letter is required
note: Supervisor's letter before applying; apply through the Swiss embassy in your country.

name: MEXT Research Student Scholarship (Embassy)
window: Embassy recommendation: opens April, closes May or June in most countries
who: Under 35, nationals of countries with diplomatic relations with Japan
value: JPY 143,000 to 145,000/month, tuition waived, airfare
english: Not required; Japanese or English per programme
note: Letter of acceptance from a Japanese professor needed after the first screening.

name: Commonwealth Master's Scholarships
window: Opens September, closes mid-October each year
who: Citizens of eligible low and middle income Commonwealth countries
value: Tuition, GBP 1,347+/month stipend, airfare, thesis and study-travel grants
note: Apply via the CSC portal and also through a nominating agency in your country.

name: Rhodes Scholarships
window: Opens June or July, closes between August and October depending on constituency
who: Ages 18 to 28 (some constituencies vary); 20+ constituencies plus Global Rhodes
value: All fees, GBP 19,000+/yr stipend, airfare, for 2 to 3 years
note: Eligibility differs by constituency; check yours first.

name: Clarendon Fund Scholarships
window: Automatic with your Oxford application; December and January course deadlines
who: All nationalities; around 130 awarded a year
value: Full course fees plus GBP 19,000+/yr grant
note: No separate application; meet the course's December or January deadline.

name: Schwarzman Scholars
window: Opens April, closes September (global) or May (China/Hong Kong/Macau/Taiwan applicants)
who: Ages 18 to 29, any nationality
value: Tuition, room, board, travel, stipend for a one-year Master's in Global Affairs
english: TOEFL 100 / IELTS 7 unless degree in English
note: Leadership record weighs as much as grades.

name: Knight-Hennessy Scholars
window: Opens June, closes early October; then apply to a Stanford graduate programme by its own deadline
who: Any nationality, within 7 years of first degree
value: Full funding for up to 3 years of any Stanford graduate degree, plus leadership programme
note: Two applications: Knight-Hennessy and the Stanford programme.

name: Vanier Canada Graduate Scholarships
window: Nominated by a Canadian university; internal deadlines September to October, agency deadline early November
who: Any nationality, nominated by the Canadian institution where you will study
value: CAD 50,000/yr for 3 years
note: You cannot apply directly; contact the university's graduate office early.

name: Australia Awards Scholarships
host: Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade
window: Opens February, closes late April or May in most participating countries
who: Citizens of participating countries in Asia, the Pacific, Africa and the Middle East
value: Tuition, return air travel, establishment allowance, living stipend, health cover
note: Priority fields differ by country; check your country profile.

name: Global Korea Scholarship (GKS)
window: Embassy track: February to March; university track: September to October
who: Under 40, nationals of invited countries
value: KRW 1,000,000+/month, tuition, airfare, one year of Korean language, insurance
english: Not required; TOPIK or English scores earn extra points
note: Choose embassy or university track; you cannot apply through both.

name: Türkiye Bursları
host: Presidency for Turks Abroad and Related Communities
window: Opens January, closes February each year
who: Under 30 for Master's, 35 for PhD; most nationalities
value: Tuition, monthly stipend, accommodation, insurance, airfare, one year of Turkish
english: Not required for most; Turkish course included
note: Application places you in a university; you do not apply separately.

name: Swedish Institute Scholarships for Global Professionals
window: Opens early February, closes late February; apply to universities by mid-January first
who: Citizens of about 40 listed countries with 3,000+ hours of work experience
value: Tuition, SEK 12,000/month, travel grant, insurance
note: University admission first via universityadmissions.se, then the SI application.

name: Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC)
window: Embassy and university tracks open December to January, close between February and April
who: Under 35 for Master's, 40 for PhD; most nationalities
value: Tuition, dormitory, CNY 3,000 (Master's) or 3,500 (PhD) per month, insurance
english: Not required for Chinese-taught; per programme for English-taught
note: A pre-admission letter from a Chinese professor strengthens the application.

name: Stipendium Hungaricum
window: Opens mid-November, closes mid-January
who: Citizens of 80+ partner countries, nominated by their home sending partner
value: Tuition, monthly stipend, housing contribution, insurance
note: Your home country's sending partner must nominate you.

name: NL Scholarship (Holland Scholarship)
host: Dutch universities and Ministry of Education
window: Opens around February, closes between February and May depending on university
who: Non-EEA nationals applying to a participating Dutch university
value: EUR 5,000 in the first year only
note: Apply through the university's own scholarship page.

name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters (all programmes)
window: Most consortia open October, close between December and February
who: Any nationality; quotas for non-EU applicants
value: Tuition, EUR 1,400/month, travel and installation, study in 2 or 3 countries
note: Browse the catalogue, then apply to up to three consortia.

name: ADB-Japan Scholarship Program
window: Apply to a participating university at least 6 months before the intake; deadlines vary
who: Citizens of ADB borrowing member countries with 2+ years' work experience, under 35
value: Tuition, monthly allowance, housing, books, insurance, travel
note: Universities in Japan, Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia, NZ, India, Pakistan, Philippines, Thailand and the US.

name: Marie Skłodowska-Curie Doctoral Networks
window: Positions advertised year-round on EURAXESS as each network recruits; most start between September and January
who: Any nationality; you must not have lived in the host country more than 12 months in the previous 3 years
value: Employment contract with salary about EUR 3,400/month gross plus mobility and family allowances, 36 months
note: These are paid research jobs, not scholarships; apply to the specific network position.

name: DAAD Research Grants (Doctoral)
window: Varies by country of origin; many close between September and November for the following year
who: Graduates from most countries outside Germany; check the DAAD database for your country
value: EUR 1,300/month, travel, health insurance, German course, research allowance; up to 4 years
english: Per host; German or English per project
note: A confirmed German supervisor is required before applying.

name: Konrad Adenauer Foundation Scholarships
window: Opens around May, closes mid-July for the following academic year
who: International students under 30 with admission to a German university and a record of social or political engagement
value: EUR 934/month (Master's) or 1,200/month (PhD), insurance subsidy, seminars
note: Values-based foundation; engagement matters as much as grades.

name: Heinrich Böll Foundation Scholarships
window: Two rounds a year, closing 1 March and 1 September
who: International students admitted to a German university; priority for non-EU applicants in some programmes
value: EUR 934/month (Master's) or 1,350/month (PhD), plus allowances and a seminar programme
note: Green and social-justice engagement is a selection criterion.

name: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarship
window: Opens January, closes March for the following September
who: Non-EU/EEA nationals with an offer from an eligible Irish institution
value: EUR 10,000 stipend plus full fee waiver for one year
note: About 60 awards a year; apply after you hold an offer.

name: VLIR-UOS Master's Scholarships
window: Varies by programme; most close between November and February
who: Nationals and residents of a list of about 30 partner countries, under 35 (initial Master's) or 40 (advanced)
value: Tuition, monthly allowance, travel, insurance, for ICP Master's programmes in Flanders
note: Apply to the programme; the scholarship decision follows admission.

name: Invest Your Talent in Italy
window: Opens January, closes around March
who: Citizens of about 20 listed countries (includes India, Vietnam, Indonesia, Türkiye, several in Africa and Latin America)
value: EUR 8,000 a year for up to 2 years plus a company internship
note: Includes an internship with an Italian company.

name: NAWA Banach and Poland My First Choice Scholarships
host: Polish National Agency for Academic Exchange
window: Opens February or March, closes April or May
who: Citizens of listed developing countries (Banach) or Eastern Partnership states; check each programme
value: Tuition and monthly stipend of about PLN 1,500 for the full Master's
note: Banach is run with the Polish development aid programme.

name: Czech Government Scholarships
host: Ministry of Education, Youth and Sports
window: Opens around June, closes 30 September for the following year
who: Citizens of listed developing countries
value: Tuition plus monthly stipend about CZK 15,000 (Master's) or 16,000 (PhD), insurance
english: English-taught study is possible; Czech-taught adds a preparatory year
note: Apply through the Czech embassy in your country.

name: Lund University Global Scholarship
window: Opens mid-January, closes early February after the admissions round
who: Non-EU/EEA fee-paying applicants
value: 25% to 100% of tuition; no living costs
note: Merit-based; apply in the same portal as admission.

name: KTH Scholarship
window: Opens 1 December, closes mid-January
who: Non-EU/EEA fee-paying applicants to KTH Master's programmes
value: Full tuition for the 2-year programme; no living costs
note: Apply to KTH first through universityadmissions.se.

name: Singapore International Graduate Award (SINGA)
host: A*STAR with NUS, NTU, SUTD, SMU
window: Two intakes: closes 1 June (January start) and 1 December (August start)
who: Any nationality; strong bachelor's or master's in science or engineering
value: Full tuition, SGD 2,700/month stipend (3,200 after qualifying exam), settling-in and airfare allowances, up to 4 years
english: Per university; TOEFL/IELTS or GRE often required
note: Research in A*STAR institutes; interviews are online.

name: Taiwan Scholarship (MOE)
window: Opens 1 February, closes 31 March in most countries
who: Most nationalities; apply through the Taiwan representative office in your country
value: Tuition up to TWD 40,000 per semester plus TWD 20,000 (Master's) or 20,000+ (PhD) per month
note: Apply to the university separately; the scholarship is confirmed with admission.

name: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships
host: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade
window: Opens 1 February, closes 28 February (most countries) for the following year
who: Citizens of eligible Pacific, Asian, African, Latin American and Caribbean countries, with 2 years' experience
value: Tuition, living allowance NZD 531/week, establishment, insurance, travel
note: Must return home for 2 years after study.

name: Melbourne Research Scholarship
window: Automatic with the graduate research application; rounds close 31 October (international) and 31 May
who: Any nationality admitted to a research degree
value: AUD 38,500/yr stipend, full fee offset, relocation grant, health cover, up to 3.5 years
note: Supervisor agreement needed before applying.

name: Pierre Elliott Trudeau Foundation Scholarship
window: Universities nominate in December; foundation deadline typically mid-January
who: Doctoral students in humanities and social sciences at a Canadian university; up to a quarter can be international
value: CAD 40,000/yr plus CAD 20,000/yr for travel and research, 3 years
note: Nomination by your Canadian university is required.

name: Ontario Trillium Scholarship
window: Nominated by the university after you apply; programme deadlines December to February
who: International PhD applicants to Ontario universities
value: CAD 40,000/yr for 4 years
note: No direct application; departments nominate top international candidates.

name: HBKU Graduate Scholarships
window: Applications usually close between January and March for the fall intake
who: Any nationality
value: Full tuition, monthly stipend, housing, health insurance, annual airfare
note: All admitted students are considered for funding.

name: Khalifa University Graduate Scholarships
window: Fall round closes around 15 January; spring round around 15 August
who: Any nationality
value: Full tuition, monthly stipend AED 6,000 to 12,000, housing, insurance, airfare
note: Research-track scholarships require a faculty sponsor.

name: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program
host: Partner universities in Africa, North America and Europe
window: Each partner university runs its own round; most close between December and March
who: Young Africans from economically disadvantaged backgrounds with a record of leadership and service
value: Tuition, living, travel, books, mentorship and leadership programme
note: Apply through a partner university such as Toronto, McGill, Edinburgh, Oxford, Ashesi or Makerere.

name: Aga Khan Foundation International Scholarship
window: Opens January, closes 31 March in most countries
who: Outstanding students from listed countries in Asia, Africa and the Middle East with no other means
value: 50% grant and 50% loan covering tuition and living, Master's priority
note: Admission to a reputable university is needed before applying.

name: JASSO Monbukagakusho Honors Scholarship
window: Recommended by your Japanese university after enrolment; rounds in April and October
who: Privately financed international students enrolled in Japan
value: JPY 48,000/month for 6 or 12 months
note: Apply through the international office after you arrive.

name: Brunei Darussalam Government Scholarship
window: Opens around December, closes mid-February
who: Citizens of ASEAN, Commonwealth and OIC member countries, aged 18 to 35
value: Tuition, BND 500/month allowance, accommodation, meals allowance, airfare, insurance
note: Places at UBD, UTB, UNISSA and KUPU SB.

name: Malaysia International Scholarship (MIS)
window: Opens around April or May, closes within about a month
who: Citizens of listed countries under 40 (Master's) or 45 (PhD) with an offer from a Malaysian university
value: Tuition plus MYR 1,500/month allowance
note: Admission offer required before applying.
